title: Battle of Eltekah
summary: Assyrian victory at Eltekah over the Egyptian force, which Sennacherib’s annals place in his third campaign.
description: Assyrian victory at Eltekah over the Egyptian force, which Sennacherib’s annals place in his third campaign. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (section “The Dilemma of Sennacherib’s Truthfulness”, pp. 29–30; Table 1, row 701, p. 39).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 713 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, section “The Dilemma of Sennacherib’s Truthfulness”, pp. 29–30; Table 1, row 701, p. 39
chronologies.note: The siege of Lachish, the Battle of Eltekah, and the assault on Jerusalem all belong to Sargon’s Ashdod campaign.
